name: sheet3d-rs-check-layout
prompt:
In server/src/studio/workflow.rs, struct Check (the [check] table of a workflow.toml): add one field after `face_views`, so a workflow can tell the anatomy checker its sheet layout (task STU-SHEET3D). One SEARCH/REPLACE, change nothing else. Replace
    #[serde(default)]
    pub face_views: Vec<String>,
}
with
    #[serde(default)]
    pub face_views: Vec<String>,
    /// STU-SHEET3D: the sheet layout the checker reads ("oc-v3"); None: the v2 sheet's four columns.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub layout: Option<String>,
}

name: sheet3d-rs-anatomy-layout
check: cd /tmp/kk-sheet3d/server && PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/kk-sheet3d-target timeout 1500 nice -n 10 cargo test --locked -j 2 studio:: 2>&1 | grep -E '^(error|warning: unused)|^test .* FAILED|panicked|-->' | head -30 ; cd /tmp/kk-sheet3d/server && PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/kk-sheet3d-target timeout 1500 nice -n 10 cargo test --locked -j 2 studio:: 2>&1 | grep -q '^test result: ok'
